elevate.move: Put real approved-library photographs inside the panel system: the hero inset and the BEHIND THE PANEL half of story steps 03-05 open onto frames of a real machine's interior or a hand holding the part, clipped by the panel seam and graded into enamel-black/amber, with the line drawing as an overlay on the photo.

Make the screws the page's motion: every seam's screws turn out a quarter-turn as its band enters, and the vent verdict and form steps drive a screw home when they resolve, so the signature moves in every section while quiet copy bands stay still.
